response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and infrastructure work, but this role is explicitly entry-level/junior-mid, and his seniority and compensation expectations would likely be a poor match. He also lacks demonstrated PostgreSQL, React, or Nest.js experience (his stack leans MongoDB, Ember.js, DLang), and there's no mention of AWS/Kubernetes/LLM work aligning with the nice-to-haves despite his agentic AI infra experience being tangential.
strengths: Extensive fullstack experience across many languages and stacks (TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, etc.)
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture) matching the 'clean architecture' interest requirement
Proven ability to learn quickly and take ownership (e.g., took over iOS/Apple TV app development successfully)
concerns: Vastly overqualified for a junior/mid-level entry role — likely mismatch in seniority, scope, and compensation expectations
No direct evidence of PostgreSQL, React, or Nest.js — core required tech stack
Long freelance/founder tenure and senior titles suggest he may seek more autonomy/leadership than this IC role offers

key_factors.factor: Missing core required stack (PostgreSQL, React, Nest.js)
Strong general fullstack and learning ability
